chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Al-Minqari, from Abdul-Razzaq, from Ma'mar, from Al-Zuhri, who said:
Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: 'I saw that all goodness has gathered in cutting off greed for what is in the hands of the people.'
ai.seo_question: What is the key to gathering all goodness according to Imam Ali ibn Al-Husayn?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) identifies the severance of hope in others' possessions (qat' al-tama') as the comprehensive source of all virtue, a concept central to Shia ethical theology. This teaching underscores that true contentment arises not merely from possessing wealth, but from liberating the heart from the desire for what belongs to others, thereby purifying the soul from envy and greed. It serves as a practical spiritual remedy for maintaining inner peace and social harmony in daily interactions.
